limitations: Approximate display geometry, not collision geometry or survey data. Original data remains authoritative.

Every simplified primitive has an identical exact-position boundary-edge set; proposed mismatches retain original data. Existing source cracks/overlaps remain.

Originals and source coordinate frames are unchanged. No height offset or z-fighting workaround is applied.
The exact reviewed house is a required fine bootstrap dependency, omitted only from duplicate fallback storage. Coherent fallback waits for its verified fine upload.
